name: obs shortcuts
description: Compact OBS Studio status bar with recording, replay buffer, broadcast controls and quick OBS restore.
author: FuncOverlay

settingsSchema.label: OBS WebSocket Host
settingsSchema.description: Host address for OBS WebSocket v5 server.

settingsSchema.label: OBS WebSocket Port
settingsSchema.description: Port configured in OBS Tools -> WebSocket Server Settings (default: 4455).

settingsSchema.label: OBS Executable Path
settingsSchema.description: Path used to launch or restore OBS Studio.

settingsSchema.label: Fallback Replay Duration (sec)
settingsSchema.description: Used if OBS profile Basic.ini replay duration cannot be read.
